chapter: New York bands and the first records
title: Throwing his marimba arrangements into the fireplace
summary: Discouraged after the Brunswick rejection, he threw twelve of his four-hammer pieces into the fireplace to Mildred's dismay.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: I was very discouraged in those years, because I played those kind of things, I'd been doing them for years, that kind of work and I'd rip about 12 tunes, like Dance of the Octopus, which was mine, In a Mist was Bix's of course --

Yeah, in -- I threw the 12 things in the fireplace, just threw them in like-- Mildred nearly died. She was --
I don't know, it's one of those impulsive -- did you ever do --
-- depressed with the whole thing about the idea.
